hooks.command: if [ -x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.venv/bin/tri-orchestrator-hook" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.venv/bin/tri-orchestrator-hook"; elif [ -x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.venv/bin/python" ]; then exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/.venv/bin/python" -m orchestrator.hook_runner; elif [ -x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.venv/bin/python" ]; then PYTHONPATH="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" exec "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../.venv/bin/python" -m orchestrator.hook_runner; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then PYTHONPATH="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}" exec python3 -m orchestrator.hook_runner; else exit 0; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $r = "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$r\.venv\Scripts\tri-orchestrator-hook.exe") { & "$r\.venv\Scripts\tri-orchestrator-hook.exe"; exit $LASTEXITCODE } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$r\.venv\Scripts\python.exe") { & "$r\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m orchestrator.hook_runner; exit $LASTEXITCODE } elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath "$r\..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe") { $env:PYTHONPATH = "$r\src"; & "$r\..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe" -m orchestrator.hook_runner; exit $LASTEXITCODE } elseif (($py = Get-Command python.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and ($py.Source -notlike "*\WindowsApps\*")) { $env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"; $env:PYTHONPATH = if ($env:PYTHONPATH) { "$r\src;$env:PYTHONPATH" } else { "$r\src" }; & $py.Source -m orchestrator.hook_runner; exit $LASTEXITCODE } else { exit 0 }
